statements.attributed: Scalable and Universal Route for the Deposition of Binary, Ternary, and Quaternary Metal Sulfide Materials from Molecular Precursors (2020) reports that the production of ternary and even quaternary materials can be achieved with excellent control of dopant homogeneity and often crystalline phase purity using molecular precursors where mixing occurs at molecular scales and metal sulfur bonds are preformed.
statements.applied_to: ternary and quaternary metal chalcogenide materials
statements.quote: Because the mixing of precursors occurs at molecular scales and metal sulfur bonds are preformed within the complexes, the production of ternary and even quaternary materials can be achieved with excellent control of dopant homogeneity and often crystalline phase purity, and the approach can be extended to a wide range of metal chalcogenide materials.
